freeze_rule: Change status to FROZEN before calculating any 72 h pathway endpoint.

primary_analysis.gene_filter: edgeR::filterByExpr using the 48 h ENDO discovery subset only
primary_analysis.gene_universe_rule: freeze the 48 h filtered genes and apply the same universe at 72 h
primary_analysis.normalization: edgeR TMM, calculated separately within each time point
primary_analysis.model: voom-limma 2 x 2 interaction model, fitted separately at 48 h and 72 h
primary_analysis.fgsea_ranking_statistic: moderated t-statistic for the interaction contrast
primary_analysis.positive_direction: stronger MMS response in WT than TP53_KO
primary_analysis.replication_rule: same 48 h and 72 h NES sign and 72 h BH FDR < 0.05

empirical_stability.gene_universe: discovery_48h_gene_universe.tsv frozen by the full 48 h analysis
empirical_stability.normalization: edgeR TMM recalculated separately in each resample
empirical_stability.model: voom-limma 2 x 2 interaction refitted separately in each resample
empirical_stability.gene_set_snapshot: hallmark_gene_sets.tsv written by the full 48 h analysis
empirical_stability.fgsea_seed_rule: full-discovery fgsea seed plus the 1-based resample index
empirical_stability.small_evidence_set_thresholds: production distill.py thresholds for baseline leading-edge sizes <=5 and <=10
empirical_stability.size_matched_sensitivity: four deterministic equal-frequency strata by full-discovery leading-edge gene count; within each stratum select the lowest-q pathways until the empirical-selection stratum count is matched

primary_comparison: empirical_stability_audit versus q_value_matched at identical K
guardrails: Do not use a normalized expression matrix as the primary differential-expression input.
Do not add DESeq2 solely for this benchmark; reuse the existing edgeR, voom, and limma pattern.
Do not use 72 h counts to choose the discovery gene filter or gene-set universe.
Do not use an LLM-assisted proposal run as the primary Priority 1 analysis.
Do not use synthetic evidence-gene dropout as the primary Priority 1 stability measure.
Do not select the primary empirical-stability tau until all prespecified 48 h calibration runs are complete.
Do not optimize candidate generation, tau, gene sets, or replication rules using 72 h outcomes.
Do not describe 72 h as an independent cohort.
Do not interpret audit PASS as biological truth, mechanism, causality, or clinical utility.
